newsitem.title: EU: Civil Liberties Committee agenda - July 7-8.
newsitem.headline: Civil Liberties Committee agenda - July 7-8.

text.p: Committee on Civil Liberties and Internal Affairs [[ Monday 07 July 1997 ]] 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.705 ) ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 2.
